narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced very heavy rain in portions of southwest Alabama.
ev: Heavy rain caused CR 12 from Highway 59 to James Road to have a significant amount of water covering the road and the road was closed.
lsr: CR 12 FROM HWY 59 TO JAMES RD HAS A SIGNIFICANT/DANGEROUS AMOUNT OF WATER ACROSS AND COVERING THE ROAD. ROAD IS CLOSED.
